Industries

Which sectors do we serve?

Every facility has different energy sources and maintenance habits. From product selection to identifying lockout points, we provide needs-specific support.

Energy and Petrochemicals

Lockout and tagout for high-risk isolation points in refineries, power plants and energy distribution facilities.

Metal and Steel

Group lockout solutions for long maintenance shutdowns on rolling mill, foundry and steel lines.

Cement and Construction

Mill, kiln and conveyor maintenance at cement plants and panel and building material facilities.

Chemical and Pharmaceutical

Safe isolation of valves, lines and pneumatic sources in chemical, cosmetics and pharmaceutical production.

Automotive and Machinery

Press, robot cell and workbench maintenance in automotive supply industry and machine manufacturing.

Food and Beverage

Lockout of filling, packaging and process machines during hygiene cleaning and line changeovers.

Packaging and Plastics

Mold changes and breakdown interventions on injection, extrusion and printing machines.

Services and Infrastructure

Technical maintenance teams in telecommunications, water, waste and public infrastructure facilities.
